# M0-5: YNAB read-only probe

- Milestone: M0
- Branch / worktree: `t/M0-5`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M0-5`
- Depends on: none
- Touches (exclusive while running): `spikes/ynab/`, `docs/build/spikes/ynab.md`
- Plan refs: architecture.md §3.1 (Sync) and §2 (Data model) only
- YNAB access: read-only live (`YNAB_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `YNAB_BUDGET_ID` from `.env`)
- Deploy: no

## Goal
Settle the YNAB API unknowns that M1-1 (client upgrade) and M1-3 (sync) depend on, using `pkg.venceslau.dev/ynab` v1.6.1
against Brendan's live plan, strictly read-only. The output is a findings doc, not product code.

## Scope
- A throwaway Go program under `spikes/ynab/` (its own `main` package; a separate `go.mod` there is fine so the root module
  stays untouched) that uses `pkg.venceslau.dev/ynab` v1.6.1.
- Full plan fetch: request count, response size, wall time, counts of accounts/categories/payees/transactions.
- Delta fetch: capture `server_knowledge`, re-fetch with `last_knowledge_of_server`; record what a delta looks like (empty
  and non-empty if anything changed), including how deletes show up (`deleted` flag).
- Subtransactions: the shape split transactions arrive in on the plan/transactions endpoints, and how to stitch them to their
  parent (ids, fields, whether amounts/categories live on parent or children).
- Account link fields: which fields show direct-import linkage and errors (e.g. `direct_import_linked`,
  `direct_import_in_error`, last reconciled/import timestamps if any).
- §3.1 assumption: among recently imported transactions, how many arrive **unapproved with a category already set**
  (YNAB payee memory) vs unapproved and uncategorized. Report counts, and a few examples with payee names only (no amounts
  needed, no account numbers).
- Rate usage: note the `X-Rate-Limit` header if the client exposes it; keep total requests well under 50.
- Write `docs/build/spikes/ynab.md`: findings each labeled VERIFIED or UNVERIFIED, a recommendation, and an
  "Impact on architecture" section.

## Out of scope
- **Any YNAB write.** No POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE of any kind, including `POST .../transactions/import`. GET only.
- Changing `ynab/`, `categorizer/`, the root `go.mod`, or any product package (that's M1-1).
- Printing or committing the token, plan id, or raw transaction dumps. Don't commit captured API responses.
- Editing `CLAUDE.md` or `docs/plan/*` (list doc follow-ups in Result instead).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] `cd spikes/ynab && go run .` completes against the live plan with GET requests only (state the request count).
- [ ] `docs/build/spikes/ynab.md` exists with VERIFIED/UNVERIFIED labels on every finding, a recommendation, and an
      "Impact on architecture" section; it answers the §3.1 payee-memory question with counts.
- [ ] `grep -rn` over the branch diff shows no token, plan id, or raw response fixtures committed.
- [ ] Root `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` still green (root module unchanged).
